description:

 Arcadia is the AI\-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale.

 Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines — united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Competitive compensation based on market standards
* We are working on a hybrid model with remote first policy
* Apart from Fixed Base Salary potential candidates are eligible for following benefits
* 
+ Flexible Leave Policy
+ Office located in the heart of the city in case you need to step in for any purpose

* We provide comprehensive coverage including accident policy and life insurance.
* Medical Insurance (1\+5 Family Members)
* Flexible Benefit Plan
* Awards and Bonus
* Annual performance cycle
* Quarterly engagement activities
* A supportive engineering culture that values diversity, empathy, teamwork, trust, and efficiency


**What We’re Looking For**
 We are seeking a
 ****Senior Staff Engineer (L6\)****
 to join Core Engineering in India as a senior individual contributor operating across squads rather than inside one. You will be the technical subject matter expert our teams pull in when the problem is hard, the design is ambiguous, or the blast radius is large — moving between our Acquisition, Extraction and Storage, and Presentment squads as priorities shift.
   

  

 This role exists because our squads are shipping faster than our design review capacity. We have driven deep adoption of AI\-assisted development across India engineering, and the constraint has moved: teams can now produce architecture and implementations quickly, but senior validation of those designs concentrates on too few people. You will be one of a small number of engineers trusted to review and approve significant designs, and to raise the design ceiling of the engineers around you.
   

  

 You will not have direct reports. Your influence comes from technical depth, design judgment, and mentorship rather than reporting lines. This is a hybrid, remote\-first role anchored in Chennai, working daily with US\-based engineering and product partners.
   

  

 Our engineering values are deeply ingrained in our culture — you can read more about them here.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Act as the floating technical SME across Core Engineering squads, embedding where the hardest current problem is and moving on once the team is self\-sufficient
* Review and approve component and service designs, sharing design authority with squad leads so that architecture approval stops being a single\-person bottleneck
* Own the design of complex, cross\-service changes spanning multiple owners — provider data model changes, extraction pipeline evolution, migrations, and event contract changes
* Write production code on the critical path. This is a hands\-on role; you will be in the repositories, not only in documents
* Set and raise the bar on non\-functional requirements: performance, scalability, reliability, observability, and cost across the services you touch
* Validate AI\-generated designs and implementations, reviewing agent output for architectural soundness, hidden coupling, and failure modes the model did not consider
* Advance how we do AI\-assisted engineering: spec\-driven development, reusable skills and subagents, prompt patterns that hold up against our codebase, and automation of recurring work
* Mentor Staff Engineers and below through pairing, design review, and constructive feedback, measurably lifting the technical judgment of the squads you rotate through
* Lead major refactoring and technical debt reduction across legacy platform services, sequencing the work so that delivery continues
* Debug and resolve complex production issues that cross service, data, and infrastructure boundaries
* Write the design documents, architecture decision records, and runbooks that make your decisions durable. Confluence is our single source of truth
* Partner with US engineering leads on cross\-region initiatives, representing India engineering in architecture discussions


**What Will Help You Succeed**
 The following list reflects our current technology stack. You will need meaningful overlap or analogous experience, but not an exact match.
   

  

****Must\-haves****
* 10–12\+ years in software engineering, with a track record of owning technically complex, multi\-service work end to end
* Deep production expertise in Python, plus working fluency in a second ecosystem such as Java and Spring Boot or TypeScript/Node
* Strong distributed systems and event\-driven architecture experience — queues, streams, idempotency, eventual consistency, and backpressure
* Hands\-on AWS (ECS/EKS, S3, Lambda, Kinesis or equivalent) and containerized deployment on Kubernetes
* Solid relational data modeling and query tuning (MySQL, Postgres), plus search or analytical stores (OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, Snowflake)
* Demonstrated ability to review other people’s designs and improve them. You can point to architectures that are better because you were in the room
* Practical, daily use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor, and of spec\-driven development, with a clear view of where they help and where they mislead
* Credibility without authority: able to influence squads you are not part of, and to mentor senior engineers without managing them
* Excellent written and verbal communication, and comfort operating across India and US time zones
* Comfort with ambiguity and rotation — the willingness to be reassigned to the highest\-value problem rather than owning one fixed surface


****Nice to have****
* Utility, energy, or fintech data domain experience
* Web data acquisition at scale (Puppeteer, headless Chrome, anti\-bot mitigation)
* Document extraction, OCR, or LLM\-based extraction pipelines
* dbt and analytics engineering on Snowflake
* Experience modernizing legacy monoliths into services while keeping delivery running


****Eliminating carbon footprints, eliminating carbon copies.****

KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R\&D. **Group/Division**
 With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next\-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost\-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers.  At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 AI Architect\- SC products: We are seeking an experienced Supply Chain AI Solution Architect to join our Digital Supply Chain Team. This hybrid role combines enterprise AI architecture, Supply Chain taxonomies and knowledge graph, product thinking, and client advisory to translate business needs into secure, scalable solutions that deliver measurable value.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to identify AI opportunities and translate requirements into scalable AI solution architectures.
* Design and architect enterprise\-grade AI applications leveraging LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, Knowledge Graphs, GraphRAG, and Multimodal AI patterns.
* Define end\-to\-end AI solution architectures, including model selection, data retrieval strategy, orchestration frameworks, deployment models, and integration patterns.
* Design and implement advanced prompting, context engineering, structured outputs, tool calling, workflow orchestration, and memory management strategies.
* Architect hybrid retrieval solutions using vector search, semantic search, GraphRAG, SQL\-based retrieval, and vectorless approaches.
* Design and implement MCP\-based integrations with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and business systems.
* Establish AI platform standards covering observability, evaluation frameworks, LLMOps, monitoring, governance, performance optimization, and cost management.
* Define AI security architectures addressing prompt injection, data leakage, unauthorized tool access, jailbreak attempts, and AI\-specific threats.
* Ensure compliance with Responsible AI principles, privacy regulations, governance requirements, and security standards.
* Conduct architecture reviews, technical assessments, proof\-of\-concepts, and production\-readiness evaluations.
* Drive AI adoption across business and technology teams through workshops, technical leadership, and stakeholder engagement.
* Mentor AI engineers, architects, and developers while defining best practices, reusable frameworks, and reference architectures.
* Stay current with emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and industry trends to drive continuous innovation.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 12\+ years of experience in software engineering, cloud architecture, data engineering, enterprise architecture, or related technology domains.
* Strong experience designing and implementing enterprise AI, Generative AI, and intelligent automation solutions.
* Hands\-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, context engineering, RAG, embeddings, reranking, and vector databases.
* Strong knowledge of AI agent architectures, multi\-agent systems, tool calling, memory strategies, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows.
* Proficiency in Python, API development, microservices architecture, and distributed systems.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform and their AI services.
* Strong understanding of databases, data platforms, event\-driven architectures, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Practical experience with MCP, REST APIs, JSON\-RPC, OAuth, and secure integration frameworks.
* Knowledge of AI evaluation frameworks, tracing, monitoring, observability, LLMOps, and AI cost optimization.
* Understanding of model fine\-tuning, LoRA/QLoRA, model routing, quantization, and inference optimization techniques.
* Experience with multimodal AI, knowledge graphs, GraphRAG, SQL agents, and advanced retrieval architectures.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, architecture documentation, and leadership skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities with a focus on delivering business outcomes.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience with frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, or equivalent orchestration platforms.
* Experience working with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, Hugging Face, or similar AI ecosystems.
* Familiarity with vector databases and search platforms such as Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, or Neo4j.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, vLLM, Langfuse, Ragas, DeepEval, and AI platform engineering practices.
* Understanding of AI governance and security frameworks, including NIST AI RMF, OWASP GenAI Security, ISO/IEC 42001, and cloud security best practices.
* Experience leading enterprise AI transformation initiatives, Centers of Excellence (CoE), or AI capability building programs.
* Exposure to MLOps, DataOps, and enterprise deployment strategies for scalable AI solutions.
* Experience engaging with executive stakeholders and presenting architecture roadmaps, AI strategies, and business cases.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:**

**Required:**
* 9\+ years of experience in cloud security, cybersecurity consulting, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, AI security, or related disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience leading client\-facing engagements or major workstreams in security, cloud, or AI\-related programs.
* Experience designing, assessing, or implementing security controls for cloud\-hosted applications, platforms, and AI/ML environments.
* Strong experience with one or more major cloud platforms, with working knowledge across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML and GenAI security concepts, including prompt injection, model misuse, data leakage, secure model access, agent security, model governance, and responsible AI controls.
* Experience implementing cloud security controls across IAM, network security, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and policy enforcement.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Bash, and PowerShell.
* Experience with DevSecOps, CI/CD, and secure engineering practices, including policy validation, secrets handling, and continuous compliance.
* Familiarity with cloud AI services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure OpenAI, Mythos, Anthropic, and Vertex AI.
* Familiarity with governance and security frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, and related control frameworks.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience communicating technical and risk matters to executive and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience leading teams, mentoring junior practitioners, and managing quality across client deliverables.


**Preferred:**
* Experience leading AI security assessments, architecture reviews, control design, remediation programs, or transformation initiatives across one or more major cloud platforms.
* Deep hands\-on experience with identity and access management, including AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, and Google Cloud IAM.
* Experience designing governance and guardrails for cloud AI environments using services such as AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, Azure Policy, Security Command Center, and equivalent policy enforcement capabilities.
* Experience with cloud\-native monitoring and security tooling such as AWS Security Hub, CloudTrail, AWS Config, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, and Google Security Command Center.

 Move Beyond Compiling Data And Help Tell The Story Behind The Numbers. In Our Department, You Will
   

  

* Architect Intelligent Workflows: Identify bottlenecks in traditional FP\&A processes (like month\-end close or manual data consolidation) and spearhead the implementation of automations and AI solutions.

**You'll Need To Have**

* Five or more years of relevant work experience in Business Intelligence/Analytics within FP\&A teams (but not limited to this function).

* Deep, hands\-on experience building AI agents or agentic systems in production.

* Familiarity with evaluation frameworks for agentic systems and understanding of the practical tradeoffs in production.
* Basic knowledge of programming languages essential for modern data and AI work (e.g., Python, Google App Scripting, React.js, etc.,).
* Background in developer tools, productivity platforms, or engineering analytics.
* Exposure to GCP Big Query and Teradata databases.

* Guide adoption of automation and scripting capabilities in geospatial analysis pipelines to reduce manual effort improve repeatability of crack propagation studies and accelerate delivery of insights to cross functional stakeholders.
* Champion the societal impact of robust geospatial and crack growth analytics by demonstrating how proactive asset integrity management enhances public safety protects the environment and supports sustainable infrastructure development.
